bus.title: Interface: RS-485 bus
bus.description:
How Home Assistant reaches the Novus RS-485 bus.

**Serial device / bridge URL:** a local device such as `/dev/ttyUSB0` or `/dev/ttyNovus300`, or a network bridge such as `socket://10.0.17.45:9700` that forwards the serial bus over TCP. Only one client can use a bridge at a time.

**Baud rate:** the Novus bus runs at 9600.

**Parity:** `none` for a bridge or an adapter that already handles the address bit, `mark` for a plain RS-485 adapter on the bus.

The integration reloads automatically afterwards.

fan_control.title: Interface: 0-10 V fan control
fan_control.description:
Optional: drives the unit's fan signal with a Tinkerforge Industrial Analog Out (0-10 V) instead of the panel's own levels.

The **helper entity** (an `input_boolean`) is switched on while the unit runs in automatic mode. Leave fan control disabled if you do not use a Tinkerforge module.

plant_form.title: Plant parameters
plant_form.description: Automatic mode, frost protection, reheating and installation types are written to the unit (like the panel menu). Empty fields stay unchanged. **Caution:** defroster type and reheating affect hardware - only set what is installed. The effect of the frost protection mode is unconfirmed.
